_about: Fast chat (FastChat.cs, 2026-10-08, David: answer chat in seconds, not ~60 s). A conversational nearby-chat line or IM that the instant replies (_instant-replies.json) did not take is answered by the client itself via the xAI chat completions API: persona below (stable, cached) + current state + the last history_lines lines of THAT conversation (nearby chat and each IM session are kept apart). The reply is claimed like 'say --re' / 'im --re' so the chat routine never answers it again. Requests to DO something: the model only writes a short ack (David only), the line goes on to the chat routine with fast_ack set, and the routine does the action. API error, timeout (timeout_s) or an empty reply: the line goes to the routine as before. Read fresh on every line; enabled=false turns it off. Key: env XAI_API_KEY, else the box secret store card.XAI_API_KEY (never logged). Token usage per call: fastchat-usage.jsonl next to the client log ('fastchat status'). 2026-10-09: outfit requests from David (JSON outfit = random | top_color | <saved outfit name>) are changed by the client itself (FastOutfit.cs): ack, change starts ~1 s after his line, model-written follow-up when done, line claimed; anything unclear/blocked/failed goes to the routine with fast_ack. How/why questions about her own behaviour/client/speed/bugs (helper=true) get only a 'let me check' ack and go to the routine. Problem reports / feedback / new behaviour rules from David also get helper=true (short 'let me look at that' ack, routine handles it). Lines from David containing 'look into' / 'look in to' always get a canned ack and go to the routine (code: FastLookIntoTrigger, no model call).
_about_typing: Typing delay before a fast reply (typing indicator on throughout): total time since the incoming line = (typing_base_s + typing_per_word_s * words) * pace_multipliers[pace] + random jitter up to +/- typing_jitter_s, capped at pace_max_s[pace] or else typing_max_s; the API time already spent is subtracted. The model returns pace = quick (playful / excited back-and-forth, quick answers), normal, slow, or thoughtful (tender, serious, emotional, or a question that needs thought); missing or unknown = normal.
